about.title: About Pouchen Group
about.subtitle: A legacy of excellence in footwear manufacturing since 1969.
about.history_p1: Founded in 1969, Pouchen Group started as a small OEM footwear manufacturer in Taiwan. Over five decades, we have evolved into one of the world's largest and most technologically advanced athletic and casual footwear manufacturers.
about.history_p2: Through our "Full-line products and value-added services" strategy, we serve global brands including Adidas, Nike, and other world-renowned sports brands. Our commitment to innovation has transformed us from a traditional manufacturer into a technology-driven industry leader.
about.mission_quote: To benefit healthy lives by providing the most valuable solutions in the sports industry.

operations.title: IT Operations — Factory 4.0
operations.subtitle: The central nervous system of our manufacturing excellence.
operations.sap_desc: The core backbone of our operations, managing enterprise resources with precision, reliability, and real-time data-driven decisions across production cycles.
operations.mes_desc: Manufacturing Execution Systems delivering real-time production monitoring, quality tracking, and work-order management on the shop floor.
operations.wms_desc: Warehouse Management Systems optimizing material storage, retrieval, and flow — ensuring just-in-time delivery to every production line.
operations.mps_desc: Master Production Scheduling aligning demand forecasting with capacity planning for seamless production orchestration.
operations.map_subtitle: Unified data flow connecting every layer of factory operations.

innovation.title: AI & Innovation Lab
innovation.subtitle: Pioneering intelligence in motion to power the future of footwear.
innovation.ai_agent_desc: Autonomous AI agents that analyze, decide, and execute complex factory workflows — reducing human intervention while maximizing output quality and speed.
innovation.agile_desc: Powered by AI Agents to adapt and deliver solutions at unprecedented speed. Iterative sprints ensure continuous improvement and rapid deployment.
innovation.vibe_desc: Our modern development philosophy — writing code with intention, creativity, and flow. Building intelligent solutions that feel natural and perform exceptionally.
innovation.automation_desc: Streamlining complex workflows and reducing manual bottlenecks across factory operations with purpose-built intelligent automation pipelines.

support.helpdesk_desc: Rapid-response helpdesk for hardware, networking, and software issues. Ensuring every team member stays productive.
